title: Orchard MEX
notes: Offline sweep by R; segment tree over values [0..N] storing last seen index, binary walk for first value with last_pos < L.

title: Dominant Banner
notes: Boyer-Moore majority candidate segment tree + per-color coordinate-compressed Fenwick tree for exact count verification.

title: Flooded Terraces
notes: Find leftmost and rightmost maximum in [L, R] via Sparse Table RMQ, then binary-lift along next-greater-right from L and prev-greater-left from R.

title: Signal Relays
notes: 4-corner prefix split on X, sweep sorted events with coordinate-compressed Fenwick tree on Y.

title: Toll Rebellion
notes: Lazy range-add segment tree maintaining (minimum coverage count, sum of lengths achieving that minimum). Covered length = total_len - (min_val == 0 ? min_sum : 0).

title: Mountain Couriers
notes: Kruskal minimum spanning tree + binary lifting for maximum edge weight on tree paths.

title: Imperial Beacons
notes: Two-pass rerooting DP: ans[v] = ans[u] + (total_W - 2 * sub_W[v]) * edge_len.

title: Ancestral Archive
notes: Root-path sum f(u) changes on subtree(w) add x by x*depth[u] + x*(1-depth[w]) for tin[w]..tout[w]; maintain slope and constant BITs + LCA.

title: Festival Lanterns
notes: dist(x, y) is even iff depth[x] == depth[y] (mod 2). DSU-on-tree maintaining counts[color][parity] and running pair sum.

title: Emergency Depots
notes: Sort query vertices by Euler tin; minimal spanning subtree weight is 0.5 * sum_i dist(v_i, v_{(i+1)%k}).

title: Guild Portals
notes: Create one virtual hub node per guild: city -> hub costs C_g, hub -> city costs 0; run Dijkstra.

title: Sunken Causeways
notes: Sort causeways and queries in descending order of height/tide; maintain DSU component sizes.

title: Critical Aqueducts
notes: Find bridges via Tarjan (tracking edge IDs for parallel pipes), contract 2-edge-connected components into a tree, answer queries via LCA distance.

title: Faction Truce
notes: Offline segment tree over time [1..T] + rollback DSU with parity bits to test bipartiteness on every day.

title: Convoy Escort
notes: 60-level binary lifting table storing destination and sum of weights over 2^b steps.

title: River Couriers
notes: dp[i] = F_i + min_{1 <= j < i} (dp[j] + A_j * D_i); non-monotone slopes & queries solved via Li Chao tree on [1, 10^6].

title: Canal Locks
notes: Partition N positive weights into K contiguous groups minimizing sum of (group_sum)^2; quadrangle inequality / monotone opt via D&C DP.

title: Rune Compatibility
notes: 20-bit Sum Over Subsets (SOS) DP over masks [0, 2^20).

title: Mercenary Watch
notes: Sort intervals by right endpoint; dp[r] = min(dp[r], W + min_{x in [l-1..r]} dp[x]) maintained in a point-min-update, range-min-query segment tree.

title: Vault Relics
notes: Precompute prefix knapsack dpL[i][w] and suffix knapsack dpR[i][w] in O(N*C), then answer each (banned k, cap c) query in O(C) via max_{0<=w<=c} (dpL[k-1][w] + dpR[k+1][c-w]).

title: Mirror Scroll
notes: Double-modulus polynomial rolling hash maintained in forward and reverse Fenwick trees.

title: Signal Interference
notes: Persistent 30-bit binary trie storing the maximum array index reaching each node; walk bits 29..0 greedily checking max_idx >= L.

title: Crystal Resonance
notes: Prefix rightmost XOR linear basis: for each prefix r, store 30 basis vectors maximizing minimum used index; query [L, R] uses vectors with pos >= L in O(30).

title: Archive Patterns
notes: Aho-Corasick automaton over all query patterns; run text T once marking visited states, then propagate counts in reverse BFS order along suffix links.

title: Twin Inscriptions
notes: Concatenate S + '#' + T, build Suffix Array and Kasai LCP array, then sweep monotonic stacks counting sum of LCPs between suffixes from opposite strings.

title: Guard Rotations
notes: Precompute best_r[x] = max_{L_i <= x} (R_i + 1) via prefix max, then binary-lift jumps from A until position > B.

title: Alchemist Vials
notes: Min-heap regret greedy: tentatively take every vial; whenever running sum < 0, eject the smallest (most negative) taken vial. Optimal for every prefix 1..i simultaneously.

title: Stepped Terraces
notes: Substitute B'_i = B_i - i (can be any integer) and A'_i = A_i - i to reduce to non-decreasing L1 regression; solve via max-heap Slope Trick in O(N log N).

title: Ore Assay
notes: Binary search integer X in [0, 10^12] testing whether max_{r-l+1>=K} sum(10^6 * G_i - X * R_i) >= 0 via prefix minimums.

title: Timber Quotas
notes: Parallel binary search over Q days for all N provinces simultaneously, using a range-add point-query Fenwick tree capped at 10^15 to avoid overflow.

title: Harmonic Chimes
notes: Precompute squarefree divisors and mu(d) up to 500,000; toggling bell x updates cnt[d] for squarefree d | A_x and adjusts pair count by sum mu(d) * cnt[d].

title: Citadel Walks
notes: Precompute binary powers G^(2^b) for b=0..59 in O(60 * N^3), then answer each (U, V, K) query via 1xN vector * NxN matrix in O(60 * N^2).

title: Sunken Courtyard
notes: Sort obstacles + target (H, W) topologically; dp[i] = ways((1,1)->p_i) - sum_{p_j <= p_i} dp[j] * ways(p_j -> p_i) in O(H + W + K^2).

title: Artisan Alloys
notes: Build polynomial P(x) = sum_i W_i x^{L_i}; compute P(x)^2 mod 998244353 via NTT, subtract diagonal sum_{2 L_i = S} W_i^2, and multiply by inv(2).

title: Prime Ledger
notes: Factorize each A_i <= 10^6 into <= 7 distinct primes via linear SPF sieve, then run offline R-sweep + Fenwick tree tracking last occurrence of each prime.

title: Surveyor Beacons
notes: Build upper and lower convex hulls via monotone chain; answer max(A*x + B*y) by binary searching edge normal slopes on upper hull (B >= 0) or lower hull (B < 0).

title: Citadel Enclosure
notes: Sort points by exact integer polar angle around (0, 0); subtract from C(N, 3) all triples contained in a semicircle via two pointers.

title: Ranked Granaries
notes: Coordinate-compressed persistent segment tree storing (count, sum); walk down diff(root[R], root[L-1]) to get both K-th smallest and sum of K smallest.

title: Guild Tributes
notes: Offline snake-order Mo's algorithm maintaining cnt[x] and delta (2*cnt[x]+1)*x in O((N + Q) * sqrt(N)).

title: Token Duel
notes: Compute Grundy values g[u] = mex{g[v]} in reverse topological order and compress neighbor Grundy frequencies per vertex so counting winning moves X ^ g[P_j] == g[v] is O(log deg).

title: Canal Sluices
notes: Max segment tree with point updates and O(log N) tree descent for smallest index >= L with H[i] >= V.

title: Banner Alignments
notes: Segment tree storing (total_sum, max_pref, max_suff, max_subarray) for non-empty subarrays with point updates.

title: Orchard Harvest
notes: Sort array elements and queries in non-decreasing order of value/threshold X; insert A_i into a Fenwick tree and query range sums.

title: Signal Modulators
notes: Segment tree storing (sum, max). Prune range-modulo recursion whenever subtree max < M; since x mod M < x/2 when x >= M, amortized cost is O((N + Q) log N log V).

title: Caravan Contracts
notes: Sweep right endpoint B from 1..N; add contract weight W_i at index L_i when R_i == B, then sum [A..B] via Fenwick tree.

title: Pilgrim Waystations
notes: Compute LCA(u, v); if K <= d(u, w) jump K steps up from u, else jump d(u, w) + d(v, w) - K steps up from v.

title: Plague Infirmaries
notes: Centroid decomposition storing best[c] = min distance from centroid c to any active infirmary in its centroid subtree; O(log N) per update and query.

title: Royal Courier Paths
notes: Heavy-Light Decomposition + iterative max segment tree for vertex updates and path maximum queries.

title: Forest Expansion
notes: Prebuild the final tree for O(1) RMQ LCA distances, then merge components in DSU tracking the two diameter endpoints {e1, e2} of each component (only 6 candidate pairs).

title: Exact-Length Trails
notes: Centroid decomposition counting pairs of nodes at depths d and K - d across subtrees in O(N log N).

title: Rival Outposts
notes: Multi-source Dijkstra starting from all N vertices simultaneously, keeping at each vertex the 2 shortest distances originating from DISTINCT clans.

title: Chokepoint Cities
notes: Construct bipartite Block-Cut Tree (original vertices 1..N + block nodes N+1..N+B); number of cut vertices strictly separating A != B is dist_BCT(A, B)/2 - 1.

title: Detour Highways
notes: Malik-Mittal-Gupta replacement paths: fix one shortest path P from 1 to N, compute d1/L_attach and dN/R_attach, sweep bypass chords over P with a min-heap.

title: Catapult Express
notes: Build a downward segment tree of virtual vertices with 0-cost internal edges; each range [L, R] connects to O(log N) segment tree nodes.

title: Chorded Tree Roads
notes: Build a spanning tree for O(1) RMQ LCA tree distances, then run Dijkstra from one endpoint of each of the <= 21 non-tree edges.

title: Formation Ranks
notes: Coordinate-compress A and maintain a Fenwick tree over pairs (max_len, ways_mod) to compute both LIS length and count in O(N log N).

title: Signal Windows
notes: Value as a function of window count k is concave over integers; WQS binary search on non-negative per-window penalty lambda reduces O(NK) DP to O(N log(sum|A|)).

title: Balanced Stones
notes: Since sum(W_i) <= 240,000, grouping identical weights and binary-splitting multiplicities yields <= ~1,200 bundles, reducing O(N * S) min-stone knapsack to O(S * sqrt(S)).

title: Subtree Alliances
notes: Rerooting tree DP modulo arbitrary composite M (no modular inverse): use prefix and suffix products over children's (down[c] + 1) factors.

title: Extremal Subarrays
notes: Divide & conquer on [lo, hi] with two monotone pointers p, q on the right half splitting min and max dominance into 3 prefix-summed regions in O(N log N).

title: Palindrome Radius
notes: Precompute odd and even Manacher radii d1, d2 with O(1) Sparse Table RMQ; for each query [L, R], binary search the largest feasible odd and even radius.

title: XOR Highway
notes: CF 888G Xor-MST: sort unique values, split recursively by highest differing bit b, connect the 0-half and 1-half via minimum-XOR binary trie query in O(N log^2 V).

title: Common Borders
notes: Build the KMP border tree on 0..N where parent(i) = pi[i]; proper borders of S[1..p] are ancestors of pi[p], so the answer is LCA(pi[p], pi[q]).

title: Substring Frequencies
notes: Build Suffix Array + Kasai LCP; decompose LCP via Cartesian-tree / monotonic stack intervals (plus freq=1 suffixes) to tabulate exact distinct-substring counts for every occurrence multiplicity 1..N.

title: Censored Chronicle
notes: Build an Aho-Corasick DFA over the K forbidden words propagating max_len along failure links; maintain a stack of (char, state) in O(|T| + 26 * sum|P_i|).

title: GCD Spectrum
notes: Ending at each index r, prefix-subarray GCDs take at most log2(max A) + 1 <= 31 distinct values; maintain compressed (gcd, length) list in O(N log^2 V).

title: Floor Harmonics
notes: Count frequencies up to V = 500,000 with prefix sums; for each distinct denominator d, iterate multiples k*d .. (k+1)*d - 1 in O(V log V) total.

title: Exact GCD Triples
notes: Count multiples mult[d] for d = 1..V, initialize ways[d] = C(mult[d], 3), and subtract ways[2d], ways[3d], ... from d = V down to 1 in O(V log V).

title: Skewer Combinations
notes: AGC001E BBQ Hard: C(A_i + A_j + B_i + B_j, A_i + A_j) counts lattice paths from (-A_i, -B_i) to (A_j, B_j); compute all pairs simultaneously on a 4005x4005 DP grid, subtract self-pairs, divide by 2.

title: Square Product Subsets
notes: Every A_i is 300-smooth (<= 62 primes), mapping to a 62-bit parity mask; maintain a rightmost XOR basis sweeping R from 1 to N so dim(L..R) is the count of basis vectors with pos >= L, giving 2^((R-L+1) - dim) - 1.

title: Skyline Shadows
notes: X-sweepline over +/-1 vertical edge events with a cover-count Segment Tree over compressed Y-intervals computing active union length in O(N log N).

title: Consecutive Blocks
notes: CF 526F: in a permutation, max(L..R) - min(L..R) - (R - L) >= 0 always; sweep R maintaining (max - min + L) in a lazy (min_val, min_cnt) segment tree updated by monotonic stacks.

title: Inversion Slices
notes: Binary search the maximum allowed inversions X per segment; greedily extend the current segment with a Fenwick tree and selectively roll back only the current segment's elements when X is exceeded — O(N log N log(N^2)).

title: Pairwise Distances
notes: Sort A, binary search the K-th difference D_K via two-pointer pair counting, then sum all differences strictly < D_K via prefix sums and add (K - cnt_lt) * D_K.

title: Platform Dispatch
notes: Sort intervals by end time R_i ascending; assign each interval [L_i, R_i) to the available track with the GREATEST current end time <= L_i using multiset::upper_bound.

title: Domino Cascade
notes: Process dominoes from right to left: binary search rightmost directly hit index reach, then far[i] = max(reach, seg_max(i..reach)); answer for i is far[i] - i + 1.

title: Oasis Pipelines
notes: 8-octant (D_4) sweepline + Fenwick min-query emits <= 8N candidate edges containing a valid Manhattan MST, solved by Kruskal in O(N log N).

title: Tinted Highways
notes: ABC133F Colorful Tree: compute LCA w = lca(A, B), decompose query into +f(A) + f(B) - 2*f(w), and answer all queries in one root-to-leaf DFS maintaining (cnt[color], sum[color]) on the ancestor stack.

title: Affine Ledger
notes: Lazy segment tree composing affine maps f2(f1(x)) = (b2*b1) * x + (b2*c1 + c2) mod 998244353 with range sum.

title: Tower Spacing
notes: ARC069F Flags: binary search minimum spacing D; sort all 2N candidate coordinates and use a virtual-clause Segment Tree + Tarjan SCC to add range conflict clauses in O(N log N log V).

title: Terraced Aqueducts
notes: Weighted Slope Trick with two run-length-encoded heaps (coord, slope_delta) and lazy offsets (shift_L, shift_R) in O(N log N); verified on small via independent monotone-deque coordinate DP.

title: Garrison Reassignments
notes: Dynamic Tree DP (DDP): decompose tree into heavy chains, maintain light-child sums g0[u], g1[u] as 2x2 (max, +) tropical matrices in a Segment Tree; each point weight update walks O(log N) chains in O(log^2 N).

title: Harbor Beacons
notes: CEOI Harbingers: dp[u] = S_u + D_u * P_u + min_{a in anc(u)} (-D_a * P_u + dp[a]); maintain an Undo-Stack Li Chao Segment Tree over compressed P_u along the DFS ancestor stack in O(N log N).

title: Segmented Convoys
notes: Calibrated so naive O(N^2 K) DP TLEs even on small (N=3500, K=1500): 40-pt subtask requires O(NK) CHT/D&C DP, and 100-pt requires WQS Binary Search + O(N) Monotonic CHT with BIG=(N+2) lexicographic tie-encoding.

title: Subtree Color Dominance
notes: Post-order Dynamic Segment Tree Merge maintaining leaf color sum S(u, c) and internal range sum of S(u, c)^2 mod (10^9+7); answers subtree color-interval queries in O((N + Q) log N).

title: Emergency Relay Cut
notes: Weighted generalization of CF 613D: build a Virtual Tree per query with binary-lifted path-minimum edge capacities, then run 2-state tree DP (dp0: 0 terminals reach u, dp1: <=1 terminal reaches u) in O((N + sum K) log N).

title: Supply Chokepoints
notes: Lengauer-Tarjan O((N + M) alpha(N)) Dominator Tree on general cyclic directed graphs; depth in the dominator tree gives the exact count of dominators for every reachable vertex.

title: Ephemeral Bridges
notes: Offline Dynamic Connectivity: map each edge's active [t_add, t_del - 1] intervals into a Time Segment Tree and traverse with a Rollback DSU maintaining sum(|C|^2) in O(Q log Q log N).

title: Imperial Research Grants
notes: Interval Project Selection Closure (CF 115E): sweep right endpoint r = 1..N with a lazy range-add range-max Segment Tree tracking net profit of contiguous repaired block [j..r] in O((N + M) log N).

title: Bipartite Dockyard
notes: Weighted generalization of ARC076F: by s-t Min-Cut / Hall's Theorem, uncut piers form a single middle interval [a+1..b-1]; sweep a = 0..M-1 with a lazy range-add range-min Segment Tree over b in O((N + M) log M). Cross-checked against 64-bit Dinic Max-Flow on small!
